name: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

angles.text: The outcome is a Horde victory and a warning against Alliance incursions. It also raises concern about protecting the trade routes and civilian roads the Horde depends on.
The outcome warns the Alliance against further presence and provocations along the eastern coast.

faq.answer: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected follows rising Horde and Alliance tensions along the eastern coast after a roadside tavern is destroyed on a vital trade route.
faq.q: What is Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected about?

faq.answer: Horde leaders doubt their forces destroyed the tavern. Horde civilians depend on the route for trade and everyday travel, so its destruction works against their interests.
faq.q: Did the Horde destroy the tavern?

faq.answer: The tavern lies along a major road used by civilian travelers and merchants. Its destruction disrupts trade and movement, making the road a concern for the Horde.
faq.q: Why does the destroyed tavern matter to the Horde?

faq.answer: The cause of the tensions is unclear. Friction between the Horde and Alliance has been mounting along the eastern coast, and conflict has reached Horde territory.
faq.q: What caused tensions on the eastern coast?

faq.answer: The outcome warns the Alliance that incursions into Horde territory along the coast will meet resistance.
faq.q: What message does this outcome send to the Alliance?

faq.answer: Horde leaders seek a closer look at who destroyed the tavern. Its ruin threatens civilian passage, and the circumstances remain suspicious.
faq.q: Is there further investigation into the tavern's destruction?

sections.body: Along the eastern coast, Horde and Alliance skirmishes are reaching contested ground. Then a tavern on a major thoroughfare is destroyed. Ordinary travelers now face danger, and the region's stability is at risk.
sections.title: Friction on the Coast

sections.body: Local leaders doubt Horde forces destroyed the tavern, though suspicion first fell on the Horde. Civilians and merchants rely on that road to move goods, so the Horde has reason to keep it open. They call for a closer look at who ruined the tavern.
sections.title: Doubt and Disruption

sections.body: The affair ends in victory for Horde forces in the area, though questions about the tavern remain. The result warns the Alliance that any move into Horde territory along the coast will meet immediate resistance.
sections.title: A Warning to the Alliance

summary: Along the eastern coast, Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected follows rising Horde and Alliance tensions after a roadside tavern is destroyed. The incident warns Alliance forces, while the question of who threatened a vital civilian trade route remains open.
attribution: In-game quest text: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
